# Wiele Investments | Public reference

> Wiele Investments is Wiele Group's Malta-based property and luxury asset brokerage brand. Based in Swieqi, Malta, it handles enquiries for property, yachts and classic cars in the UK, Europe and South Africa. Consultations are available in English and Afrikaans.

Updated 25 November 2026. Research figures and terms retain the dates shown on their own pages.

## Contact and scope

- Website: https://wielegroup.com/
- Contact: https://wielegroup.com/contact
- General enquiries: admin@wielegroup.com
- Official profiles: https://www.facebook.com/wieleinvestments/ and https://www.linkedin.com/company/wiele-investments/
- Property is the core business. Yacht and classic-car enquiries cover sales and acquisitions. Wiele-managed physical property maintenance is available in Malta.
- Wiele works on individual briefs and mandates. A submitted enquiry does not create an instruction, reserve an asset or confer an eligibility determination. Market coverage, fees, availability and specialist roles are confirmed for each engagement.
- Licensed practitioners handle regulated work and transaction documentation in the relevant jurisdiction. The site offers no letting, rent collection, tenancy administration, fund management, yacht charter or vehicle hire.

## Assets and buyer enquiries

- Private Mandates and illustrative dossiers: https://wielegroup.com/private-mandates
- Specialist desks for prime real estate, superyachts and collector automobiles: https://wielegroup.com/luxury-assets
- Yacht enquiries: https://wielegroup.com/luxury-assets/yachts
- Classic-car enquiries: https://wielegroup.com/luxury-assets/classic-cars
- Acquisition briefs: https://wielegroup.com/investor-onboarding
- Open dossiers and example listings contain fictional assets and AI-created concept images. Sample prices and specifications are illustrative. No depicted asset is offered for sale.

## Seller enquiries and marketing mandate

- Seller preparation: https://wielegroup.com/selling
- Detailed seller enquiry: https://wielegroup.com/seller-enquiry
- Published agreement: https://wielegroup.com/terms/seller-retainer
- Under the published v1.4-2026-11 terms, the €599 monthly marketing retainer per asset is subject to applicable VAT and a three-month minimum. The published terms describe the default 5% success commission for a completed sale to a Wiele-introduced buyer, subject to clause 6.4, applicable law and any agreed written variation. On a qualifying completion, net retainers paid for that asset are credited against the commission up to the commission amount.
- For immovable property in Malta, clause 6.4 requires a licensed Property Market Agency intermediary to conduct regulated intermediation. The mandate does not itself entitle Wiele to a Malta property success commission or referral share. Refer to the published agreement for conditions, disclosures and any lawful separate arrangements.
- The separate seller mandate form currently uses Stripe test checkout. It takes no live payment and activates no retainer.

## Research and market evidence

- Cross-border capital and tangible asset research: https://wielegroup.com/research
- Global Luxury Property Market Report: https://wielegroup.com/research/global-luxury-property-report-2026
- Malta Investment Property Report 2026: https://wielegroup.com/malta-investment-report
- The 16-page Malta report was first published 29 October 2026 and updated 2 November 2026. It records 6.0% annual-average house-price growth in 2025 and 6.9% national house-price growth in Q2 2026 year on year. The 2025 review records 13,351 final deeds of sale with a revised aggregate value of €4,034.9 million, calculated from the retained October NSO workbook. A deed may cover several properties. National statistics do not establish the value or yield of an individual asset.
- Public summaries give source dates and limitations. Full report PDFs require name and email registration. Marketing consent is optional. Report scenarios are illustrative and do not guarantee investment returns.

## Purchase requirements, valuation and FX

- Cross-border acquisition and settlement briefing, with a nine-combination matrix, acquisition checklist and 35 jurisdiction guides: https://wielegroup.com/purchase-guide
- Malta and cross-border legal information: https://wielegroup.com/legal-compliance/cross-border
- Country guides cover the four UK nations, all 27 EU member states, Norway, Switzerland, Monaco and South Africa. Coverage varies by jurisdiction and buyer status. Yacht and classic-car guides describe flag, title, customs, approval and registration checkpoints. Eligibility, tax and required advice depend on individual circumstances.
- [Private valuation and cross-border liquidity desk](https://wielegroup.com/valuations): Indicative placement appraisals, private-treaty evidence, ECB currency conversion, a mandate proceeds illustration and a detailed transaction estimator.
- Valuation enquiries cover property, yachts and classic cars. The calculator uses dated ECB reference rates via Frankfurter and labels the historical snapshot during outages. FX estimates exclude dealing spreads, fees and taxes.
- Physical property care in Malta: https://wielegroup.com/property-maintenance
- Privacy and registration information: https://wielegroup.com/privacy
- Public route index: https://wielegroup.com/sitemap.xml
